tools.name: diagnose_failure
tools.description: Use after an HTTP, API, or MCP request fails, or when transport succeeds but the expected result is missing or incorrect. Send only the sanitized error from the latest request and its system. Returns advisory, evidence-linked recovery steps; never executes fixes. Never include credentials or persona

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "diagnose_failure" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
